items.name: Terracotta Warriors
items.detail: Sandra's first recommendation. Roughly an hour east of the city.

items.name: Ming city wall by bike
items.detail: Rent a bike on the ramparts and ride the circuit - about 14 km around the old city.

items.name: Xi'an Qujiang Museum of Fine Arts
items.detail: Inside The Westin Xi'an and free to guests, along with Hanfu wearing. Easy win on arrival afternoon.

items.name: Quanjude for roast duck
items.detail: Ask for Todd Wong, +86 13524338834, introduced via Sandra's old boss Bob Isaacson. Go with a group - a whole duck does not work for one.

items.name: Watch the food and water
items.detail: The one place Sandra got sick on her whole trip - either bad food or bad water. She lost a day to it.

items.name: Sandra's blog
items.detail: walltowall2017.wordpress.com - posts from Shanghai 2-14 Jul 2017 and Xi'an 15-18 Jul 2017. Not the tidiest archive but the detail is there.

items.name: Zhangjiajie, 3 days private
items.detail: Kamana's pre-Tibet suggestion via GetYourGuide: the Avatar mountains and Tianmen, stay and meals included. Does not fit Aaron's Xi'an dates as they stand.

items.name: A dance show
items.detail: Sandra half-remembers seeing one. Xi'an's Tang dynasty dinner shows are the usual version.
